text:
rachel: Ok team  launching RefKit Sparks next Tues. Goal: drive repo stars, tutorial completions, and demo env signups. Need final launch post, benchmark pull-quote, and webinar plan.

jamal: Love the name. Proposed cadence: 3 short tutorials (10-15m each) released Mon/Tues/Wed, big launch post Thurs, webinar Friday. Or we can bundle all tutorials into the launch post. Thoughts? :thinking_face: 

li: Preference to drip tutorials to keep momentum. Each tutorial should include a tiny reference app + one benchmark card (before/after). That makes the learning tangible.

priya: Agree. Benchmarks we should highlight: p50 latency, cost per 100k tokens, and cold start time for the demo. For the narrative, recommend framing as: "how we trimmed inference cost for a customer-style refapp" not raw % claims without context. Legal review required for any headline with numbers.

brandon: KPIs from growth: repo stars, forks, tutorial completions, demo env signups, and marketing-sourced MQLs. Benchmarks CTA: "See the numbers" should go to a collapsible section on the post with graphs.

rachel: Landing form plan: hubspot form name = refkit_sparks_signup. Fields: first_name, last_name, email, org, role, repo_interest, opt_in. Hidden: source=refkit_sparks, hero_variant. Make sure HubSpot tags map to campaign = refkit_sparks_2026.

jamal: Social + paid split: organic on launch, small paid spend to dev-communities + Reddit. A/B hero copy for socials so we can test narrative.

li: Hero copy options: 
  A) Ship a working LLM refapp in under 30 minutes  step-by-step tutorials + benchmarks.
  B) Reduce inference cost for your refapp  see the before/after benchmarks + code.

priya: B for audiences already worried about cost; A for newcomers. We should use B in tech channels (Hacker News, r/MachineLearning) and A on Twitter/X and newsletter.

brandon: I'll set the social plan and UTM tags. UTM campaign=refkit_sparks_2026, utm_source=twitter|hn|reddit, utm_medium=social.

rachel: Webinar plan: 40m total. Structure: 10m why (market/customer problem), 15m live-coding refapp walkthrough, 10m benchmark/optimization case study, 5m CTA + Qs. Speakers: jamal (host + roadmap), li (live-coding), priya (benchmark narrative). Record and gate the deck behind the form.

push-bot: Deployment intention: staging.refkit.redwood.dev -> sparks branch scheduled at 2026-04-02T09:00:00Z. status: pending. :rocket:

jamal: Demo env checklist for infra: - small instance with quantized model - prefix KV caching enabled - sample dataset (customer-sim) - rate limits to avoid abuse. Li can share docker-compose and quickstart.

li: Quickstart snippet for README: 
```
pip install refkit-sparks
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-xxxxx
python examples/refapp.py --model=gpt-small-quant --enable-kv --port=8080
```

priya: For the benchmark slide, I'll produce a small table and two charts: latency distribution and $/100k tokens. Will include notes on measurement method and environment so it's reproducible.

brandon: Inbound routing: HubSpot workflow -> tag lead as source:refkit_sparks -> push to #sales-inbound with context: repo_interest + role. Also create an automation to add leads to a nurture sequence for 2 weeks.

rachel: Legal/Comms quick checks: priya to run numbers by legal for wording; jamal to share a draft post by Wed EOD. Email cadence: launch announcement + reminder 48h + webinar reminder 2h.

li: I'll drop tutorial repo links and Dockerfiles by Tue EOD.

jamal: Who owns the launch post draft? I'll write base draft, rachel will edit for brand tone, priya will add benchmark section.

rachel: Good. Also plan a lightweight community thread on Reddit and GH Discussions with intro + AMA window after webinar. Tess? (not in thread) can run the AMA if available.

brandon: Small add: create a short one-minute demo video (30-60s) for socials. I'll storyboard and get a quick capture during Li's run-through.

rachel: Final acceptance checklist before publish: 1) Draft post ready + approved, 2) Benchmarks reviewed by legal, 3) Landing page + HubSpot form live and tested, 4) Demo env deployed and smoke-tested, 5) Social assets + UTM links staged, 6) Webinar registration enabled and calendar invite set.

priya: I ran a quick smoke and recorded baseline numbers; nothing final but will post artifacts in the doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/ExampleBenchmarks

jamal: timeline recap: Tue tutorials start drip, Thu long-form post + social, Fri webinar 10am PT, follow-up office hours Wed next week. Everyone ok?

li: :thumbsup:
priya: :thumbsup: (will ping legal)
brandon: :thumbsup: I'll queue the social images in Contentful.

rachel: Great. If no objections I'll lock the publish plan and push calendar invites. Thanks team! :raised_hands:
